name: BrainiLab recorded quiz rounds: October–November 2026
selection: Completed website game sessions with one recorded result, selected by completion time. Excludes known administration accounts, records without verified answers and invalid verified totals. Repeat rounds count separately.

method.median: Middle round accuracy after sorting; average of the two middle values for an even number of rounds.
limitations: This sample counts recorded completions, not starts, visits, or all guests.
A profile can contribute multiple rounds and may appear in more than one game or difficulty.
Excludes known administration accounts; other test use may remain.
The dates and selection differ from the first-200 snapshot; neither is a matched sample or a measure of growth, retention, or learning gains.

privacy: Aggregate counts only; no raw play records, individual scores, timestamps, identifiers or answers.
